items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: I mean Coleman Hawkins had to have listened to Paul [inaudible] and Rudy what’s his name —

ctx.x: Without qualification. Yeah, Richard Sudhalter. Who was a good musician, a good person, and had all of the right motives but I don’t think jazz has ever been racially separated ever since its inception you know? I mean Coleman Hawkins had to have listened to Paul [inaudible] and Rudy what’s his name —
